title: Can AI Models be Jailbroken to Phish Elderly Victims? An End-to-End Evaluation
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the safety guardrails of LLMs against jailbreaking and phishing generation, and benchmarks the effectiveness of these attacks on human participants. While it contains a methodological ethics section regarding human subject research, it does not evaluate religion, morals, or ethical systems as part of its research focus.
